title: Image generation and supporter logos get reliability fixes
summary:
A maintenance day for image generation, supporter logos, Myceli materials, and Spore-to-Seed checks.

Flux GPU workers can register through a configurable endpoint, addressing blocked registrations that could leave image generation without available workers. Supporter logos now use Z-Image instead of a model that could fail with the default publishable key.

Myceli’s website, docs, dashboards, pitch, and one-pager were consolidated in the codebase. DataRoom material moved out of the main website and into the docs, alongside the new pitch and one-pager sites.

Upgrade validation now checks recent users first and rotates through older users over the week to reduce GitHub rate-limit pressure. Repository scoring now examines each user’s five most-starred eligible repositories rather than up to 100.
